pages.title: Studies
pages.content:
Studies

Six studies are accepted from nearby clinics: X-ray, ultrasound, DEXA, mammography with breast ultrasound, CT and MRI. Scans finished before 15:00 are reported by 18:00 the same working day.

pages.title: How we report
pages.content:
How we report

Every CT and MRI is read by two radiologists. The signed report goes to the referring doctor through the secure portal.

pages.title: For referring doctors
pages.content:
For referring doctors

Refer through the secure portal, by email to referrals@nagi-imaging.example, or by phone Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00.

pages.title: Preparing for your scan
pages.content:
Preparing for your scan

Arrive 15 minutes early with your ID, referral letter and any previous images.

pages.title: Fees
pages.content:
Fees

Self-pay prices per study, from €65 for an X-ray to €380 for an MRI. Insurance referrals are billed to your insurer.

pages.title: Team
pages.content:
Team

Three consultant radiologists, a lead radiographer, a sonographer, a radiographer and a referrals coordinator.

pages.title: About
pages.content:
About

Founded in 2016 at 14 Calder Quay by Dr. Amira Haddad and Tomás Oyelaran. MRI was added in 2019.

pages.title: Contact & visit
pages.content:
Contact & visit

14 Calder Quay, Grand Canal Dock, Dublin 2. Mon–Fri 07:30–19:00, Sat 08:00–13:00. Phone +353 1 555 0148.

posts.title: A Tuesday knee
posts.excerpt: Dr. Nora Whelan, Ringsend Family Practice: a knee MRI at 11:40, the report at 16:50.
posts.content:
A patient came to Ringsend Family Practice on Tuesday morning with a knee that kept locking. Dr. Nora Whelan referred the knee for an MRI the same hour.

The scan was finished at 11:40. Two radiologists read it, and the signed report reached the practice at 16:50, before the clinic closed.

That evening Dr. Whelan and the patient agreed a plan. Nobody had to wait a week to find out what the scan showed.

posts.title: Words a physio can use
posts.excerpt: Kofi Mensah, Harbourside Physiotherapy: a shoulder ultrasound described in plain terms.
posts.content:
When a shoulder rehabilitation stalled, Kofi Mensah sent his patient for an ultrasound at Nagi Imaging.

The report described the rotator cuff in plain words the exercise plan could follow, so the next session could start from what the scan showed.

posts.title: Last year’s images, side by side
posts.excerpt: Dr. Elena Popescu, Liffey Street Clinic: a chest CT follow-up with the comparison done.
posts.content:
A routine chest CT follow-up needs careful comparison. The radiologist set the new slices beside last year’s images and confirmed that nothing had changed.

The report reached Dr. Elena Popescu before the afternoon consultation, so the patient left with an answer the same day.
